Density extrapolation: model progression

Progress: upper velocity gave the largest improvement, quality fields added further gains, and total reflectivity (dbz_all) added a small increment. All models use 6.6/6.6 VID thresholds, 1,446,106 training profiles, and 20,682,097 training rows, with unchanged target sampling and evaluation rows. Density remains the prediction target.

Model Cumulative additions Inputs Selected rounds
Baseline Density shape, target gap/AGL, location, seasonal/night-time terms and upper VID 38 5,585
+ u/v Upper-layer horizontal velocity components 96 12,107
+ quality Upper-layer sd_vvp, n_dbz, angular gap flag 183 19,920
+ dbz_all Upper-layer total reflectivity 212 19,875

Each added field has 29 upper-only slots. Missing values stay missing; hidden lower layers are excluded. The dbz_all fit early-stopped at 20,175 rounds, below its 30,000 ceiling; earlier fits had 20,000-round ceilings.

Mean error across 100–500 m

Evaluation Baseline + u/v + quality + dbz_all
Historical reporting 64.704 59.901 58.065 58.018
Held-out year (2025) 65.597 60.884 58.646 58.374
Held-out sites 68.222 65.095 62.324 62.058
Held-out sites + year 68.923 65.955 62.779 62.540

Arithmetic mean of the five depth-specific RMSE values, in birds/km³. Historical = separate nights at familiar sites; year = 2025; sites = 21 excluded radars; sites + year = those radars in 2025. These are evaluation scores, not the stopping-validation preview.

Against the u/v model, quality fields reduced mean RMSE by 3.1–4.8% across the four evaluations. Adding dbz_all then reduced it by 0.08–0.46%. The gains are descriptive, not significance tests.

Scope

These repeatedly inspected holdouts are development evaluations. A single fit does not establish seed robustness or statistical significance, and masking measured layers does not directly validate naturally missing layers. The latest comparison also allowed a larger round ceiling.

Only this performance tab is updated. Profile examples and feature importance still describe the previously published u/v model.

Reproduce: Rscript analysis/model-progress/render.R. Paired metrics are in analysis/model-progress/comparison.csv; collect.py checks matching evaluation counts and exact reproduction of intermediate baseline scores. Run records: conus-depth1to10-upperuv-20261009-01, conus-depth1to10-upperquality-20261012-01, and conus-depth1to10-upperdbzall-20261013-01.
